user.title: UltraWideLock
user.description: Add live UWB data, history, events, and dashboard cards. Reading works without changes to Matter Server. Enable writable controls only if you want to change UltraWideLock-specific distances and action policies from Home Assistant.

data_description.enable_writable_controls: Requires installing the bundled custom-cluster schema in the Matter Server app. The next step provides instructions.

writable_setup.title: Enable writable controls
writable_setup.description:
Complete these steps before finishing setup:

1. Open the **Terminal & SSH** app.
2. Run `sh /homeassistant/custom_components/uwb_matter/install_matter_schema.sh`.
3. Open **Settings > Apps > Matter Server > Configuration**.
4. Press the three dots and choose **Edit in YAML**.
5. Add:
```yaml
matter_server_env_vars:
  - NODE_OPTIONS=--import=/config/ultrawidelock-cluster.mjs
```
6. Save the app configuration. Confirm below, finish this integration flow, then restart Matter Server and Home Assistant.

data.setup_confirmed: I installed the schema and added the Matter Server environment variable

error.setup_not_confirmed: Complete the Matter Server steps and confirm before continuing.

init.title: UltraWideLock settings
init.description: Choose whether to manage live-data freshness or detected UWB devices.

matter_binding.title: Matter lock binding
matter_binding.description: Choose the UltraWideLock whose standard Matter Door Lock bindings you want to inspect or change.

binding_action.title: Matter lock binding
binding_action.description: Adding or removing a binding preserves every unrelated entry in the existing binding table.

add_binding.title: Add a bound lock
add_binding.description: Choose a Matter Door Lock endpoint. If the required permission is missing, the integration will offer to add a narrowly scoped ACL entry before creating the binding.

confirm_acl.title: Grant Matter access to the lock
confirm_acl.description: **Warning:** Matter ACL changes are security-sensitive. An incorrect or interrupted ACL write could cause Home Assistant or another controller to lose Matter access to this lock. The integration will preserve every existing entry, add only CASE Operate access for this UltraWideLock to the selected Door Lock endpoint, verify the result, and automatically restore the original ACL if creating the binding fails. If all Matter administrator access is nevertheless lost, the lock may need to be factory-reset and commissioned again.

data.confirm_acl_risk: I understand the risk and want to add the required ACL permission

remove_binding.title: Remove a bound lock
remove_binding.description: Only the selected Door Lock binding is removed. Other bindings remain unchanged.

data_freshness.title: UWB data freshness
data_freshness.description: This setting is independent of device names. It determines how long Home Assistant may show the latest live distance and movement when Matter updates stop arriving. After this timeout the data is marked stale and live values are cleared.

data_description.stale_timeout_seconds: Use a short value to hide frozen data quickly. The default is 15 seconds.

credentials.title: Detected UWB devices
credentials.description: Choose a detected credential to give it a friendly name or remove its automatically created occupancy sensor.

credential.title: UWB device settings
credential.description: Configure UWB credential `{credential_id}`. Its occupancy sensor turns on only when this specific device is in range of the selected UltraWideLock. Turn the option off to remove that sensor.

data.create_presence_sensor: Create an occupancy sensor for this device

data_description.friendly_name: For example: Personal iPhone or Apple Watch.
data_description.create_presence_sensor: Creates a standard Home Assistant occupancy binary sensor attached to every UltraWideLock that sees this credential. Disable it to remove the sensor while retaining the friendly name.

error.binding_acl_missing: The target lock ACL does not grant this UltraWideLock node CASE Operate access. Add that ACL permission first; no binding was written.
error.binding_write_failed: Matter Server could not update the binding table. Check that the UltraWideLock is connected and that this Home Assistant fabric has Manage permission.
error.acl_risk_not_confirmed: Confirm the warning before changing the lock ACL.
error.acl_write_failed: Matter Server could not safely add or verify the required ACL permission. No binding was created.

abort.no_ultrawidelocks: No available UltraWideLock nodes were found.
abort.no_matter_locks: No other Matter Door Lock endpoints were found.
abort.no_door_lock_bindings: This UltraWideLock has no Door Lock bindings to remove.
abort.binding_write_failed: Matter Server could not create the binding. Any ACL change made by this flow was restored.
abort.acl_rollback_failed: Creating the binding failed and the original ACL could not be restored automatically. Check the target lock ACL in Matter Server immediately; another Matter administrator or a factory reset may be required.
